stem: [洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法]在采用基于风险的方法(RBA)的反金融犯罪(AFC)计划中哪些策略最有效用于资源优先级排序？(选择两项.)

options.A: 将资源优先分配给风险较低的领域以减轻工作负担
options.B: 定期重新评估风险以调整资源配置
options.C: 向金融犯罪风险较高的领域分配更多资源
options.D: 向所有部门提供同等资源以保持一致性
options.E: 使用不作调整的固定资源分配计划

stem_en: Which strategies are most effective for prioritizing resources within an anti-financial crime (AFC) program using a risk-based approach (RBA)? (Choose two.)

options_en.A: Prioritizing resources toward lower-risk areas to reduce workload
options_en.B: Regularly reassessing risks to adjust resource allocation
options_en.C: Allocating more resources to areas with higher financial crime risk
options_en.D: Providing equal resources to all departments to maintain consistency
options_en.E: Using a fixed resource allocation plan without adjustments
